name: Ferienhaus Osterauer
beschreibung: The Ferienhaus Osterauer is located in the hamlet of the same name in the municipality of Erl, directly on the Inn. The location on a side street ensures a quiet setting with a view of the Kaisergebirge. The accommodation is divided over two floors and is designed for four to six guests. The amenities include a sauna, a covered parking space, and a fully equipped kitchen. Marked hiking trails start from the house, and in winter the ski areas Zahmer Kaiser and Wilder Kaiser are easy to reach. The Festspielhaus with its annual theater and opera program is within walking distance. The atmosphere is quiet and offers space for relaxation. The holiday home is suitable for couples or families who want to enjoy the region in both summer and winter.
